definitions.gloss: to promise, to make a commitment
definitions.explanation: To give one's word to do or not do something.

definitions.gloss: to make an appointment, to arrange to meet
definitions.explanation: To agree on a time and place to meet someone.

examples.japanese: {秘密|ひみつ}を{守|まも}ると{約束|やくそく}した。
examples.english: I promised to keep the secret.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{映画|えいが}を{見|み}る{約束|やくそく}をした。
examples.english: I made plans to see a movie with my friend.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}は{守|まも}らなければならない。
{子供|こども}に{毎日|まいにち}{本|ほん}を{読|よ}むと{約束|やくそく}した。
examples.english: I promised my child that I would read a book every day.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}ってしまったので、{友達|ともだち}に{謝|あやま}らなければならない。
examples.english: I broke my promise, so I have to apologize to my friend.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{会|あ}う{約束|やくそく}をした。
examples.english: We made plans to meet tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}と{三時|さんじ}に{約束|やくそく}がある。
examples.english: I have an appointment with the teacher at three o'clock.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{土曜日|どようび}に{会|あ}う{約束|やくそく}をしていたのに、{急|きゅう}に{仕事|しごと}が{入|はい}ってしまった。
examples.english: We had made plans to meet next Saturday, but work suddenly came up.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}の{時間|じかん}に{遅|おく}れないでね。
examples.english: Don't be late for the time we agreed on, okay?

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}の{場所|ばしょ}に{着|つ}いたけど、{相手|あいて}がまだ{来|き}ていなかった。
examples.english: I arrived at the meeting place we agreed on, but the other person hadn't come yet.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {約束|やくそく}を{守|まも}る: to keep a promise
- {約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}る: to break a promise
- {約束|やくそく}の{時間|じかん}: the promised time, appointment time

USAGE:
In Japanese, {約束|やくそく} is used both for formal promises/commitments and casual appointments/plans to meet.
